feature_definitions.short_safe_portal: for a 1D region intersection only: sigmoid((threshold - safe_portal_length) / softness); unavailable until threshold and softness are explicitly configured
feature_definitions.all_paths_mandatory: removing this connection disconnects every start-region/goal-region pair
feature_definitions.degree: number of unique neighbors in the retained undirected connection graph
